name: Shichihou Ruria
source:
Class President. She appears laid-back, but she’s a “brilliant” girl who can send boys straight to hell with a single, merciless remark.

She’s always fuming over “Yuni’s” words and actions, which defy common sense due to her twisted sense of morality.

She has the largest bust size of the three, but it seems to be a source of insecurity for her.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/24250/?gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
